method: Research agent reviewed official product documentation and license files. The author checked the category claims against official sources.
limits: Not documented means the reviewed sources did not establish a capability.
Products within each category have different capabilities.
No performance, adoption or maintenance cost comparison was measured.

products.name: Dockview
products.audience: Developers building browser applications with IDE layouts
products.layout: Tabs, groups, drag movement, floating panels, popouts and saved layouts
products.license: Free MIT core; commercial Enterprise features

products.name: Golden Layout
products.audience: Developers arranging application components in a browser
products.layout: Component registration, drag movement, popouts and saved layouts

products.name: Lumino
products.layout: DockPanel, movable tabs and saved layouts

products.name: Monaco
products.audience: Developers embedding the VS Code editor
products.editor: Code editor, models and language providers
products.fileGitShellAdapters: Application supplies host integrations; models represent opened files

products.name: CodeMirror
products.audience: Developers embedding an extensible web editor
products.editor: Syntax highlighting, completion, folding, search and extensions

products.name: Ace
products.audience: Developers embedding a JavaScript code editor
products.layout: Sessions support application tabs; workspace docking not documented
products.editor: Syntax highlighting, search, folding and multiple selections
products.fileGitShellAdapters: Application supplies host integrations; the optional command line is not an OS terminal

decisions: Lead with custom workspaces and connected panes, not unique docking.
Treat layout and editor products as different starting points.
Separate browser components from the included local Bun adapters.
Do not claim that tabs or saved layouts are unique to Pane System.
Use links to official sources in the README comparison.
